import math
def control(obs):
    rails=obs['local_map']
    a=rails['left_rail']; b=rails['right_rail']
    pts=[((p[0]+q[0])/2,(p[1]+q[1])/2) for p,q in zip(a,b)]
    near=min(range(len(pts)),key=lambda i:pts[i][0]**2+pts[i][1]**2)
    target=pts[-1]
    dist=0.0
    last=pts[near]
    for p in pts[near+1:]:
        seg=math.hypot(p[0]-last[0],p[1]-last[1])
        if dist+seg>=4.0:
            f=(4.0-dist)/max(seg,0.001)
            target=(last[0]+f*(p[0]-last[0]),last[1]+f*(p[1]-last[1]))
            break
        dist+=seg; last=p
    u,v=target
    k=2*v/max(u*u+v*v,1)
    desired=math.degrees(math.atan(3.65*k))
    hitch=obs['hitch_deg']
    steer=math.degrees(math.atan(2.75*k))+1.5*(hitch-desired)
    steer=max(-34,min(34,steer))
    speed=-min(1.1,0.7+0.4/(1+15*abs(k)))
    if abs(hitch)>45: speed=-0.4
    return steer,speed,180

import math

def clamp(x,a,b): return max(a,min(b,x))
def dist(p,rail):
    best=100.0
    for a,b in zip(rail,rail[1:]):
        dx=b[0]-a[0]; dy=b[1]-a[1]
        t=clamp(((p[0]-a[0])*dx+(p[1]-a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy+1e-12),0,1)
        best=min(best,math.hypot(p[0]-a[0]-t*dx,p[1]-a[1]-t*dy))
    return best
def control(obs):
    rails=obs['local_map']; l=rails['left_rail']; r=rails['right_rail']
    x=1.35; y=0.0
    for _ in range(12):
        y=clamp(y+0.55*(dist((x,y),l)-dist((x,y),r)),-2.0,2.0)
    k=2*y/(x*x+y*y)
    desired=math.degrees(math.atan(0.85*k))
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    steer=clamp(1.65*(h-desired)-math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*k)),-45,45)
    speed=-0.45 if abs(h)<30 else -0.25
    return steer,speed,180

import math

def control(obs):
    rails=obs['local_map']
    left=rails['left_rail']; right=rails['right_rail']
    mids=[((a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2) for a,b in zip(left,right)]
    look=12.0
    candidates=[p for p in mids if p[0]>1]
    if not candidates:
        return (0,0,180)
    x,y=min(candidates,key=lambda p:abs(math.hypot(p[0]+1.9,p[1])-look))
    x+=1.9
    curvature=2*y/max(16,x*x+y*y)
    desired=math.degrees(math.asin(max(-0.70,min(0.70,10.2*curvature))))
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    feed=math.degrees(math.atan(3.9*math.sin(math.radians(h))/(10.2+0.35*math.cos(math.radians(h)))))
    steer=max(-42,min(42,feed+1.65*(h-desired)))
    speed=1.3 if abs(desired)<15 else 0.9
    if abs(h-desired)>18: speed=0.65
    if abs(h)>53:
        wake('High articulation; braking for review')
        return (steer,0,180)
    return (steer,-speed,180)
